test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence from passive to active voice:

The antique vase was restored by the curator.

options.text: The curator restores the antique vase.
The curator was restoring the antique vase.
The curator had restored the antique vase.
The curator restored the antique vase.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• In the given passive voice sentence: "The antique vase was restored by the curator." 
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the curator" at the beginning.
